verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt's API can take an agent-supplied document, manage signers and auto-detect signature fields. It routes the document through a notarization workflow, not a lightweight e-signature flow, and webhooks report completion. llms.txt helps an agent use the docs, but the product does not draft documents, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: NDA/document drafting or templates, a plain e-signature routing flow (as opposed to notarization), an MCP server, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent flow.
